name: Rending Grasp
description: Take a fold of cloth or leather in both hands and rend it open with a twist.

name: Tearing Guard
description: Catch a lunging blade between the palms and tear the grip from the wielder.

name: Ripping Step
description: Rip free of a grasp with a hard step that tears the hold across its weakest finger.

name: Rift Flick
description: Flick a thread of tearing qi that opens a rift in a strap or a sleeve.

name: Wrench Hold
description: Wrench the foe's hand away from the pommel with a sudden outward pull.

name: Great Rend
description: Rend a leather coat and the muscle beneath it in a single heavy two-handed pull.

name: Riving Thrust
description: Thrust stiffened fingers into a seam of armour and rive the plates apart from within.

name: Guardbreak Palm
description: Strike the centre of a raised guard where it is thinnest and shake it open.

name: Hammer Brace
description: Brace the forearms and let a heavy blow break itself against them.

name: Shatter Stride
description: Stride through a cracked line of ground that breaks open under the next pursuer.

name: Buckle Strike
description: Strike the knee of a guarding leg and buckle the stance at the joint.

name: Splitting Flick
description: Flick a spark of splitting qi at a wooden shield and watch the grain open.

name: Crush Grip
description: Crush the rim of a foe's shield in one hand until its hold on the arm breaks.

name: Guard Collapse
description: Break the foe's guard at its weakest point and drive on through the gap it leaves.

name: Plate Shatter
description: Drive a hard heel-of-hand blow into plate and shatter it along its own rivets.

name: Nullifying Palm
description: Press a palm against one gathered bolt of qi and unmake that bolt where it stands.

name: Dispel Touch
description: Touch a foe's gathering move and unmake the knot of qi before it can release.

name: Fizzle Step
description: Step through the place where a qi trap sits and unmake it as the foot comes down.

name: Snuffing Strike
description: Strike through a flame or a charge of qi held in the foe's hand and snuff it.

name: Technique Undoing
description: Unmake one cast technique mid-flight and leave the foe's reserve of qi spent for nothing.

name: Hexwork Undoing
description: Unmake the single curse laid on an ally without touching the person beneath it.

name: Crumbling Palm
description: Strike a mortared surface with a palm that sets the mortar crumbling.

name: Sagging Guard
description: Let the guard sag under a heavy blow so that the force tears itself apart.

name: Crumbling Step
description: Step off a ledge as it crumbles and land clear of the falling stone.

name: Mortar Flick
description: Flick a bead of unmaking qi at the joint between two stones and weaken it.

name: Pillar Tap
description: Tap a post or pillar at its bearing point so the load above it shifts.

name: Settling Rubble
description: Let broken stone settle round the foe's feet and drag at his stride.

name: Keystone Strike
description: Strike the keystone of a built thing so that the whole piece shudders and falls.

name: Foundation Crack
description: Crack the footing under a small group so that their ground heaves and fails.

name: Binding Unmaking
description: Unmake the cord of a binding spell about an ally and let the loose end drop.
